## Professional Summary
Satyajit Das is a Pharmacy student at Haldia Institute of Pharmacy and BBA scholar at Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE). He specializes in healthcare technology, hospital pharmacy workflows, pharmacovigilance, and modern web application development. He is the founder and lead developer of MediTrack, an intelligent healthcare management and hospital internship tracking platform.
